title: Tacoma, in rain
logline: The bus's window somewhere past Tacoma, rain, the reflection of a seat with nobody in it, the road's lights. The page is a window. He never sat at it.

panels.composition: A bus window at night in rain from inside: the streaks, the highway lights smeared, and in the glass the reflection of the seat beside the window, empty, its headrest. Nobody. The route, from where she'd have sat.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bus window at night from inside with rain streaking it and highway lights smeared beyond, the glass reflecting an empty seat's headrest, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: From her seat. Nobody in it.
